import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_3.csv"
]

# Years corresponding to each source file in order
years = [2013, 2014, 2015, 2016]

# List to hold each year's dataframe with renamed columns
dfs = []

for file_path, year in zip(source_files, years):
    # Read source CSV, ignoring the first index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Rename columns Wins, Losses, Draws to year-specific columns
    df_renamed = df.rename(columns={
        "Wins": f"{year} Wins",
        "Losses": f"{year} Losses",
        "Draws": f"{year} Draws"
    })
    
    # Keep only relevant columns: Wrestler and renamed stats
    df_renamed = df_renamed[["Wrestler", f"{year} Wins", f"{year} Losses", f"{year} Draws"]]
    
    dfs.append(df_renamed)

# Merge all yearly dataframes on 'Wrestler' using outer join to keep all wrestlers
from functools import reduce

target_df = reduce(lambda left, right: pd.merge(left, right, on="Wrestler", how="outer"), dfs)

# Fill NaN values with 0 for all numeric columns (wins, losses, draws)
stat_columns = [col for col in target_df.columns if col != "Wrestler"]
target_df[stat_columns] = target_df[stat_columns].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    "Wrestler",
    "2013 Wins", "2013 Losses", "2013 Draws",
    "2014 Wins", "2014 Losses", "2014 Draws",
    "2015 Wins", "2015 Losses", "2015 Draws",
    "2016 Wins", "2016 Losses", "2016 Draws"
]

target_df = target_df[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns to match target schema for each year
# Source3_1_0 -> 2013 columns
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

# Source3_1_1 -> 2014 columns
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

# Source3_1_2 -> 2015 columns
df2_renamed = df2.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

# Source3_1_3 -> 2016 columns
df3_renamed = df3.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Join all tables on Wrestler (inner join to keep only wrestlers present in all years)
df_joined = df0_renamed.merge(df1_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner') \
                       .merge(df2_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner') \
                       .merge(df3_renamed, on='Wrestler', how='inner')

# Group by Wrestler and sum all numeric columns (in case of duplicates)
group_cols = ['Wrestler']
agg_cols = [col for col in df_joined.columns if col != 'Wrestler']

df_final = df_joined.groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)[agg_cols].sum()

# Write to output CSV
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_1/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
